integrity: Universal result proved using PNT in fixed arithmetic progressions, Brun–Titchmarsh and a tail count; finite code is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to squarefree semiprimes with distinct prime factors. The 1979 original paper and 2007 density paper were bibliographically identified but not inspected in full; no independent validation has been performed. OEIS date is the earliest exact-day public-source record located, not the inception of the subject.
title: The exact first-order asymptotic for non-Duffinian squarefree semiprimes
